name: subagent-lifecycle-audit
description: Records append-only subagent start and stop metadata and blocks common direct mutations of the lifecycle trail.

interface.shortDescription: Audit subagent starts, stops, and lifecycle gaps.
interface.longDescription: Records lifecycle metadata for spawned subagents without storing prompts, responses, commands, file paths, or tool payloads.
interface.defaultPrompt: Summarize the recorded subagent lifecycle sessions.
